note: A18 candidate. Scores = c4's rank-average of 5 seeds (LightGBM, 396 members, turnover-neutral 5/10/20-day label), unchanged. Rule = c4 (85/13/2, other bucket CSI1000-only top-110 keep 4x, exclusion 20%/35% on turnover-neutral percentiles) + additional veto of the worst 10% CSI500 names on a rule-based fundamental distress composite (cash-flow accruals, non-standard audit, shareholder-count growth, insider net selling 60d, pledge ratio, single-quarter revenue growth, SUE x low turnover; direction fixed on 2016-2018, PIT with availability < signal date), CSI500 bucket weighted by vendor free-float cap (free_share x price) instead of float cap x implied multiplier. The composite was chosen after the 2019-2024 in-bucket single-factor table (the pre-registered v1 composite had no effect); 2025/2026 were looked at once, after the rule was fixed.
universe: CSI300 U CSI500 U CSI1000 constituents by effective date; eligible = non-ST, non-delisting, listed >= 120 sessions, positive amount
timing: scores from data through the close of t; orders at the open of t+1; first holding day earns open[t+2]/open[t+1]-1; benchmark = CSI500 price index, same timing
book: two buckets: w500 of NAV in CSI500 names, woth in other union names, rest cash; CSI500 bucket = cap^gamma weights, exclusion below x_out (re-entry above x_in), overweight 1+tau above y_in (until y_out); other bucket = top-noth hysteresis; scores = union percentile, EWM span `smooth`
cost: one-way `cost` x fraction of NAV traded per day
replay: python -m quanta_agents.factor_lab_a.competition eval --panel-dir <panel> --prediction scores_<period>.parquet --years ... (cfg flags from rule.json)
